task: Open /home/user/Documents/blue_bg.png in GIMP as the background layer. Add /home/user/Documents/red_fg.png as a new layer on top. Give the red layer a layer mask that holds a left-to-right black-to-white linear gradient (black at the left edge, white at the right edge), so that the red fades into the blue across the image: pure blue at the left edge, pure red at the right edge, and a red/blue blend in the middle. Flatten and export the result as PNG to /home/user/Documents/mask_gradient.png. Output must be 400x300.

verification.description: Left edge (x=0) reveals blue (mask fully hides red)
Right edge (x=399) shows red (mask fully reveals red)
Midpoint is a blend of red and blue (not pure red or pure blue)

cli_feasibility.translation: Use Python with PIL: Create gradient mask array, apply to blend two images based on mask - complex but possible
cli_feasibility.reason: Layer mask with gradient requires creating alpha mask programmatically - very complex
